# registry_policy_engine_config (Data Source)

Reads the rego policy engine bundle configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "registry_policy_engine_config" "current" {}

output "policy_bundle_status" {
  value = data.registry_policy_engine_config.current.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `bundle_etag` (String) ETag of the currently loaded bundle.
- `bundle_url` (String) URL from which the rego bundle is loaded.
- `last_loaded_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp when the bundle was last loaded.
- `status` (String) Bundle load status ('ok', 'error', etc.).
